title: cuMES normalized configuration (cumes-config-v1)
description: Canonical, deterministic JSON form of a validated cuMES problem (ValidatedProblem::normalize_to_json). This is the schema v1 *configuration* contract (blueprint §6.1/§6.13); the on-disk state containers are frozen separately by the reader/writer modules and are summarized under 'x-cumes-on-disk-contracts' below for a single artifact of record. Golden files: tests/fixtures/solovev.normalized.json, tests/fixtures/w7x.normalized.json (pinned by test_host_config).

stages.description: Radial-grid stages with strictly increasing ns (each stage's ns greater than the previous — the grid-prolongation precondition ns_new > ns_old); any positive count, the v1 output records active dimensions.

x-cumes-on-disk-contracts.title: frozen on-disk state containers (blueprint §6.13)

versioned-binary-v1.description: magic 'CUMES001' (8 bytes); int32 version = 3; int32 ns; int32 mnmax; six families (mode-major doubles, rmncc/zmnsc/lmnsc/rmnss/zmncs/lmncs); then a provenance trailer: int32 precision (0=double,1=float); int32 status; int32 total_iter; int32 nstages; strings build.revision, u8 build.dirty, build.build_type, build.precision_policy, build.compile_flags, input.source_path, input.source_hash, runtime.gpu_name, runtime.driver, runtime.runtime, runtime.toolkit (each int32-length-prefixed; no scalar_type string — the precision tag is authoritative); per-stage int32 ns/iterations, u8 converged, f64 fsqr/fsqz/fsql, int32 nrestarts + int32 restart iterations; finally the embedded normalized-input record as the LAST trailer element (version 3 only): int32 mpol/ntor/nfp/ntheta/nzeta/ncurr, f64 delt/phiedge/pres_scale/adiabatic_index/spres_ped/bloat/curtor/tcon0, schema string, then int32-counted vectors am/ac/ai/aphi/raxis_c/zaxis_s (f64), the input stages (int32 nstages_in, per stage int32 ns/max_iter + f64 ftol), the raw boundary rbc_m/rbc_n/rbc_value and zbs_m/zbs_n/zbs_value (int32/int32/f64), and the folded rbcc/rbss/zbsc/zbcs (f64), counts capped at 2^20. Historical version-1 files carried a scalar_type string between build_type and source_path and no policy fields; the reader consumes and discards it. Versions 1-2 carry no input record (the reader reports a default-empty one).

versioned-checkpoint-v1.description: magic 'CUMECKP1' (8 bytes); int32 version = 2; int32 precision = 0 (always double on disk); int32 ns; int32 mnmax; six families (mode-major doubles); version 2 appends the embedded normalized-input record after the families (the restart path reads the state only; version-1 checkpoints without the record remain readable). Header mismatch or corrupt input is an error, never a silent cold start.

x-cumes-on-disk-contracts.endianness: little-endian; a reader on a big-endian host must byte-swap explicitly
